# Ashish Nagmoti

> AI Engineer and Researcher at ESDS Software Solution Ltd., specializing in LLM inference, AI infrastructure, sovereign AI, RAG systems, GPU infrastructure, and enterprise AI platforms.

Ashish Nagmoti is an AI Engineer and Researcher based in Maharashtra, India. He works on production-oriented AI systems, with a focus on large language models, inference infrastructure, GPU computing, retrieval-augmented generation, AI platforms, security, governance, and sovereign AI architectures.

He is a B.Tech graduate in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science from K.K. Wagh Institute of Engineering Education and Research, with a 9.1 CGPA.

Ashish's current work is focused on making AI systems reliable, scalable, secure, sovereign, and practical for enterprise environments.

This site (https://ashish-nagmoti.tech) presents the same information in an interactive macOS-inspired interface; this file is the plain-text version for agents.

## Sovereign AI Research

A major area of Ashish's interest is sovereign and decentralized enterprise AI.

He explores architectures where sensitive enterprise data remains within the organization or department that owns it, while AI systems can still collaborate through controlled, verifiable information exchange.

Key principles include:

* Data should not need to move to enable AI collaboration.
* Departments can maintain independent data and vector stores.
* AI systems should not automatically gain access to underlying documents.
* Cross-domain communication can happen through controlled claims rather than raw documents.
* Authorization should be enforced at the data-owning node.
* Cryptographic identity and signed policies can establish trust.
* The orchestration layer should not automatically be trusted with sensitive data.

## SovereignRAG

### SovereignRAG — Decentralized Enterprise AI

SovereignRAG is an architecture for decentralized enterprise RAG in which sensitive data remains at its source.

The system is designed around independent organizational nodes containing their own:

* Documents
* Vector databases
* Retrieval systems
* Access policies
* Cryptographic identities

Instead of moving documents or embeddings between departments, nodes can release signed claims or permitted information according to locally enforced policies.

The architecture explores:

* Decentralized RAG
* Data sovereignty
* Zero-trust AI architectures
* Cryptographic trust
* Signed claims
* Policy-driven retrieval
* Enterprise AI governance
* Disclosure control
* Cross-department AI collaboration

The project was developed as part of the ESDS Swaraj CloudForge Hackathon 2026 by Team Patronus.

## AI Security

Ashish is interested in security architectures specifically designed for AI and LLM systems.

Areas include:

* LLM access control
* AI governance
* Model/API authentication
* Data sovereignty
* Retrieval authorization
* Policy-controlled AI systems
* Secure model serving
* Enterprise AI security
* Trust boundaries in AI architectures
* Protection against unauthorized data disclosure

A recurring design principle in his work is that an LLM should not itself be treated as the authority that decides whether sensitive information may be accessed.

## GPU and Inference Engineering

Ashish works with GPU-backed AI infrastructure and investigates practical problems around deploying and serving large models.

Areas of experimentation include:

* NVIDIA GPU infrastructure
* L40S
* H100/H200-class infrastructure
* CUDA
* GPU memory requirements
* Model serving
* vLLM
* KServe
* Hugging Face model runtimes
* GPU utilization
* Multi-GPU communication
* Inference throughput
* Concurrent inference workloads
* Power and thermal behavior
* AI infrastructure sizing

He is particularly interested in the engineering gap between running a model successfully and operating inference infrastructure reliably at enterprise scale.

### System Map — Isometric Codebase Visualizer

GitHub:
https://github.com/ashish-nagmoti/codebase-isometric-visualizer

A Claude Code skill that analyzes a codebase and generates an interactive isometric blueprint representing its real routes, functions, models, and database tables.

The system emphasizes source-grounded visualization: project information is derived from the actual codebase rather than being invented by the visualization layer.

Technology:

* Claude Code
* HTML
* SVG
* JavaScript

### StoryMail — AI-Powered Smart Email Platform

GitHub:

## Technical Philosophy

Ashish is particularly interested in the engineering problems that appear when AI moves from experimentation into production.

His interests include:

* How to serve large models efficiently
* How to build reliable AI infrastructure
* How to keep enterprise data sovereign
* How to enforce authorization around RAG
* How to make AI systems observable
* How to build secure AI agents
* How to operate GPU infrastructure efficiently
* How to make AI platforms usable by developers and enterprises

He prefers systems where security, infrastructure, and governance are architectural properties rather than features added after the AI system is built.
